sections.title: B-1: Inspection
sections.summary: Introduces Appendix B's inspection checklist, spanning materials, equipment, base condition, embedded steel/dowel bars, concrete batching/placement/consolidation/finishing/curing, joint sawcutting, opening to traffic, joint dowel bar installation, joint sealing, grooving, and cracking/spalling/acceptance -- detailed in the following subsections.
sections.body: Appendix B (Inspection and Testing Checklist) supplements the CQC plan review discussed in Chapter 3, Section 3-11.4, providing an itemized checklist for field inspection covering the full construction sequence from materials receipt through joint sealing and final acceptance. The B-1 (Inspection) items are detailed in the following subsections; B-2 (Testing) items follow afterward.
key_points: Appendix B supports the CQC plan review process described in Chapter 3, Section 3-11.4
B-1 covers field inspection items; B-2 (later sections) covers testing items
Spans the full construction sequence from materials through joint sealing and acceptance
sections.applicability: Introduces the Appendix B inspection checklist and its relationship to the CQC plan review process.

sections.title: B-1.1: Materials
sections.summary: Materials inspection checklist: cement/fly ash tickets from approved sources; approved liquid admixture type/manufacturer matching submitted mix designs; water testing; approved curing compound, joint sealant, backer rod, expansion joint filler; certifications for embedded steel and dowel bars; and approved epoxy for dowel bar grouting.
sections.body: Materials inspection items: cement and fly ash tickets conforming to accepted and approved sources; approved liquid admixture type and manufacturer conforming to submitted mixture designs; water testing requirements (suitable for concrete); approved curing compound type and source; approved joint sealant and type; approved backer rod material; approved expansion joint filler and dimensions; certifications for embedded steel and dowel bars; and approved epoxy for dowel bar grouting.
key_points: Verify cement/fly ash tickets against approved sources, and admixture type/manufacturer against submitted mix designs
Confirm approved curing compound, joint sealant, backer rod, and expansion joint filler
Verify certifications for embedded steel and dowel bars, and the approved epoxy for dowel bar grouting
sections.applicability: Applies to the materials-receiving inspection checklist before and during construction.

sections.title: B-1.2: Equipment
sections.summary: Equipment inspection checklist: batch plant inspection; scale/water meter/liquid admixture dispenser certification; batch plant and agitator truck mixer uniformity tests; clean haulers; daily slipform/spud/pan vibrator frequency and amplitude verification; sufficient saws; curing compound coverage/uniformity tests approved; saw blades suited to the coarse aggregate type.
sections.body: Equipment inspection items: batch plant inspection completed; certification of scales (load cells/belts), water meters, liquid admixture dispensers; batch plant and agitator truck mixer uniformity tests; concrete haulers clean and free of debris and oil; daily verification of slipform vibrator frequency and amplitude; verification of spud vibrator and pan/surface vibrating screed frequency and amplitude; sufficient number of saws to minimize potential for random cracking; curing compound coverage and uniformity tests approved; and saw blades suitable for the coarse aggregate type.
key_points: Certify scales, water meters, and liquid admixture dispensers; run batch plant/agitator mixer uniformity tests
Daily verification of slipform, spud, and pan/surface vibrator frequency and amplitude
Ensure a sufficient number of saws and saw blades suited to the coarse aggregate type, to minimize random cracking
sections.applicability: Applies to the equipment-readiness inspection checklist before construction begins.

sections.title: B-1.3: Base Condition
sections.summary: Base condition checklist: grade acceptance; no equipment damage from loose debris; granular-base moisture conditioning; bond breaker application on stabilized base; no standing water or frost; transverse grade checks off string lines or forms.
sections.body: Base condition inspection items: grade acceptance; no equipment damage from loose debris; moisture conditioning of base (granular); application of bond breaker (stabilized base); no standing water or frost; and transverse grade checks off of string lines or forms.
key_points: Verify grade acceptance and absence of standing water/frost before paving
Confirm granular base moisture conditioning or stabilized base bond breaker application, as applicable
Perform transverse grade checks off string lines or forms
sections.applicability: Applies to inspecting base condition immediately before concrete placement.

sections.title: B-1.4: Embedded Steel and Dowel Bars
sections.summary: Embedded steel/dowel bar checklist: tie bar length/diameter/epoxy coatings; dowel bar length/diameter/coatings meeting project requirements; dowel basket location/elevation/orientation/alignment; dowel baskets secured to base.
sections.body: Embedded steel and dowel bar inspection items: tie bar length, diameter, and epoxy coatings; dowel bar length, diameter, and coatings meeting project/plan requirements; dowel basket location, elevation, orientation, and alignment; and dowel baskets secured to base.
key_points: Verify tie bar and dowel bar length, diameter, and epoxy coating against project/plan requirements
Verify dowel basket location, elevation, orientation, and alignment
Confirm dowel baskets are securely fastened to the base before concrete placement
sections.applicability: Applies to pre-placement inspection of embedded steel and dowel bars, a priority CQC checkpoint given dowel misalignment's performance impact.

sections.title: B-1.5: Concrete Batching
sections.summary: Concrete batching checklist: stabilized stockpile pads if required; aggregate contamination mitigation; uniform stockpile loading; consistent moisture via sprinkling; use of actual aggregate moisture content; computer batch printouts (date/time/mixing time/dry weights/water/admixtures); documented added-water procedures; minimum mixing times meeting uniformity test requirements.
sections.body: Concrete batching inspection items: use of stabilized pads for aggregate stockpiles (if required); procedures to mitigate aggregate contamination; uniform stockpile loading; sprinkling for consistent aggregate moistures; utilization of actual aggregate moisture contents; computer printouts of date, time, mixing time, dry batch weights, water, and liquid admixtures; procedures to document added water after batching; and minimum mixing times meeting mixer uniformity testing requirements.
key_points: Verify stockpile management (stabilized pads if required, uniform loading, contamination mitigation, moisture consistency)
Verify computer batch printouts capture date, time, mixing time, dry weights, water, and admixtures
Document any added water after batching, and confirm minimum mixing times meet uniformity testing requirements
sections.applicability: Applies to inspecting the concrete batching process at the plant.

sections.title: B-1.6: Concrete Placement Conditions
sections.summary: Placement conditions checklist: concrete placed within specified time after batching; cold weather requirements (air temp, ice-free aggregates, initial concrete temp); hot weather conditions; plastic shrinkage potential factors; foggers/windbreaks/evaporative retardants available in hot weather; polyethylene sheeting available for rain.
sections.body: Concrete placement conditions inspection items: concrete placed within specified time after batching; cold weather requirements (air temperatures, no ice in aggregates, initial concrete temperatures); hot weather conditions (air temperatures, initial concrete temperatures); plastic shrinkage potential (air temperatures, initial concrete temperatures, relative humidity, and wind speed); foggers, windbreaks, and evaporative retardants (hot weather) are available; and polyethylene sheeting (or other approved covering) available in the event of rain.
key_points: Verify concrete is placed within the specified time after batching
Verify cold-weather (temperature, ice-free aggregates) and hot-weather condition compliance
Confirm foggers/windbreaks/evaporative retardants and rain coverings are available on-site
sections.applicability: Applies to inspecting environmental/weather-related placement conditions before and during paving.

sections.title: B-1.7: Concrete Placement
sections.summary: Placement checklist: uniform placement in front of paver; no large entrapped air pockets/voids at the vertical slipformed edge; accurate transfer of sawed transverse joint locations; control chart action/suspension limits.
sections.body: Concrete placement inspection items: uniform placement in front of paver; no large pockets of entrapped air or voids at vertical slipformed edge; transferring of accurate location for sawed transverse joints; and control chart action/suspension limits.
key_points: Verify uniform concrete placement in front of the paver
Check for entrapped air pockets/voids at the vertical slipformed edge
Confirm control chart action/suspension limits are being tracked during placement
sections.applicability: Applies to inspecting the active concrete placement operation.

sections.title: B-1.8: Concrete Consolidation and Finishing
sections.summary: Consolidation/finishing checklist: closed surface and adequate consolidation at inserted dowel bars; minimizing floating/finishing after strike-off/consolidation; minimizing water application during final finishing.
sections.body: Concrete consolidation and finishing inspection items: closed surface and adequate consolidation at inserted dowel bars; minimizing concrete floating/finishing after striking off and consolidation; and minimizing application of water to surface during final finishing.
key_points: Verify closed surface and adequate consolidation specifically at inserted dowel bar locations
Minimize concrete floating/finishing beyond what strike-off and consolidation already achieved
Minimize water application during final finishing
sections.applicability: Applies to inspecting consolidation and finishing operations behind the paver.

sections.title: B-1.9: Concrete Placement Tolerances
sections.summary: Placement tolerances checklist: verify interior thickness and at slipformed edges regularly; check final elevation of transversely stretched wire; edge slump checks; edge shoring needs/procedures; straightedge testing.
sections.body: Concrete placement tolerances inspection items: verify interior thickness and at slipformed edges regularly; check final elevation of wire stretched transversely across pavement; edge slump checks; edge shoring needs and procedures; and straightedge testing.
key_points: Regularly verify interior and slipformed-edge thickness
Perform edge slump checks and straightedge testing
Verify edge shoring needs/procedures are being followed
sections.applicability: Applies to inspecting dimensional/tolerance compliance during and after placement.

sections.title: B-1.10: Concrete Curing
sections.summary: Curing checklist: curing compound applied within 60 minutes of final finishing; coverage rates/uniformity; vertical longitudinal edges covered; minimum curing temperature requirements.
sections.body: Concrete curing inspection items: application of curing compound within 60 minutes of final finishing; curing compound coverage rates and uniformity; vertical longitudinal edges covered with curing compound; and minimum concrete curing temperature requirements.
key_points: Curing compound must be applied within 60 minutes of final finishing
Verify coverage rate/uniformity and that vertical longitudinal edges are covered
Confirm minimum concrete curing temperature requirements are being met
sections.applicability: Applies to inspecting curing compound application timing, coverage, and temperature compliance.

sections.title: B-1.11: Joint Sawcutting
sections.summary: Sawcutting inspection checklist: sawcut depth (initial and reservoir cuts); alignment relative to transverse joint dowel baskets; acceptable spalling/raveling amounts; sawcut carried through the vertical edge; water/slurry containment.
sections.body: Joint sawcutting inspection items: sawcut depth (initial and reservoir cuts); alignment in relation to transverse joint dowel baskets; acceptable amounts of spalling/raveling; sawcut carried through vertical edge; and water/slurry containment.
key_points: Verify both initial and reservoir sawcut depths
Verify sawcut alignment relative to transverse joint dowel baskets
Confirm the sawcut is carried completely through the vertical edge, with acceptable spalling/raveling and water/slurry containment
sections.applicability: Applies to inspecting the joint sawcutting operation.

sections.title: B-1.12: Opening to Construction Traffic
sections.summary: A single checklist item: verify minimum strength and time requirements are met before opening the pavement to construction traffic.
sections.body: Opening to construction traffic inspection item: minimum strength and time requirements. This checkpoint applies the criteria discussed in Chapter 3, Section 3-3 (Early Pavement Trafficking) before allowing hauling equipment or other construction traffic onto new concrete.
key_points: Verify minimum strength and time requirements before opening to construction traffic
This checkpoint applies the Chapter 3, Section 3-3 early pavement trafficking criteria
sections.applicability: Applies to the go/no-go inspection before allowing construction traffic onto new concrete.

sections.title: B-1.13: Joint Dowel Bar Installation (Construction Joint)
sections.summary: Construction-joint dowel installation checklist: dowel bar elevation/spacing/alignment/minimum clearance from transverse joints; dowel bar diameter; drilled hole dimensions per specification/plan; epoxy injection procedure; use of epoxy retainer disks.
sections.body: Joint dowel bar installation (construction joint) inspection items: dowel bar elevation, spacing, alignment, and minimum clearance from transverse joints; dowel bar diameter; drilled hole dimensions meeting specification/plan requirements; epoxy injection procedure; and use of epoxy retainer disks. Dowel bar diameter and drilled hole dimensions are verified against the project's own specification/plan requirements -- this UFC's construction-practice chapters (8-5.2.3) govern the drill-and-epoxy installation procedure itself but do not print a diameter-versus-slab-thickness sizing table; sizing is a design decision from UFC 3-250-01 or UFC 3-260-02.
key_points: Verify dowel bar elevation, spacing, alignment, and minimum clearance from transverse joints
Verify dowel bar diameter and drilled hole dimensions against the project's specification/plan requirements
Confirm the epoxy injection procedure and use of epoxy retainer disks
This checklist item pairs directly with the drill-and-epoxy installation procedure in Chapter 8, Section 8-5.2.3
sections.applicability: Applies to inspecting dowel bar installation at construction joints -- the checklist companion to the drill-and-epoxy procedure in Chapter 8.

sections.title: B-1.14: Joint Sealing
sections.summary: Joint sealing checklist: sealant reservoir dimensions; reservoir cleanliness; backer rod placement; sealant curing temperatures meeting manufacturer's recommendations; recessed sealant depths.
sections.body: Joint sealing inspection items: sealant reservoir dimensions; reservoir cleanliness; backer rod placement; sealant curing temperatures meet manufacturer's recommendations; and recessed sealant depths.
key_points: Verify sealant reservoir dimensions and cleanliness before sealing
Verify backer rod placement and sealant curing temperature against manufacturer recommendations
Confirm recessed sealant depths after installation
sections.applicability: Applies to inspecting joint sealing operations, complementing Chapter 9's hot-poured/cold-poured/preformed sealant procedures.

sections.title: B-1.15: Grooving
sections.summary: Grooving checklist: groove depth and spacing requirements; clearance requirements at joints.
sections.body: Grooving inspection items: groove depth and spacing requirements; and clearance requirements at joints.
key_points: Verify groove depth and spacing against the specified pattern (standard or trapezoidal)
Verify clearance requirements at joints and other exclusion zones
sections.applicability: Applies to inspecting airfield grooving operations, complementing Chapter 8, Section 8-9.1.

sections.title: B-1.16: Cracking, Spalling, and Acceptance
sections.summary: Final acceptance checklist: unacceptable cracking and spalling criteria; repair of cracking and spalling.
sections.body: Cracking, spalling, and acceptance inspection items: unacceptable cracking and spalling criteria; and repair of cracking and spalling.
key_points: Apply the project's unacceptable cracking and spalling criteria at final inspection
Verify repair of any cracking/spalling found before acceptance
sections.applicability: Applies to final pavement acceptance inspection for cracking and spalling defects.

sections.title: B-2: Testing
sections.summary: Introduces Appendix B's testing checklist, spanning aggregate testing, concrete sampling/fabrication/curing, concrete flexural strength testing, core length (thickness) testing, and smoothness testing -- detailed in the following subsections.
sections.body: The B-2 (Testing) items complement the B-1 (Inspection) items, providing a checklist for the testing activities that verify material and construction quality, detailed in the following subsections.
key_points: B-2 covers testing checklist items, complementing the B-1 inspection items
Spans aggregate testing, concrete sampling/fabrication/curing, flexural strength testing, core length testing, and smoothness testing
sections.applicability: Introduces the Appendix B testing checklist subsections that follow.

sections.title: B-2.1: Aggregate Testing
sections.summary: Aggregate testing checklist: gradation and durability test requirements; daily sampling frequency off belt or from representative stockpiles; control chart action/suspension limits; representative aggregate moisture sampling; moisture determination frequency; flat and elongated aggregate testing frequency.
sections.body: Aggregate testing checklist items: gradation and durability test requirements; sampling for gradations at daily frequencies off belt or representative samples from stockpiles; control chart action/suspension limits; representative sampling for aggregate moistures; determination of aggregate moistures at specified frequencies; and frequency for flat and elongated aggregate requirements.
key_points: Verify daily gradation sampling (off belt or representative stockpile samples) and durability test requirements
Verify representative aggregate moisture sampling at specified frequencies
Verify flat and elongated aggregate testing frequency and control chart action/suspension limits
sections.applicability: Applies to the aggregate testing checklist supporting Chapter 10's CQC aggregate testing guidance.

sections.title: B-2.2: Concrete Sampling, Fabrication, and Curing
sections.summary: Concrete sampling/fabrication/curing checklist: sampling location/frequency/randomness; fresh sample transport (moisture loss prevention); air content/slump frequency and control chart limits; beam mold water-tightness/warping; vibration/consolidation sequence; vibrator equipment inspection; initial curing moisture/temperature control; specimen transport to lab; final curing temperature/conditioning.
sections.body: Concrete sampling, fabrication, and curing checklist items: sampling location on grade, frequency, and randomness requirements; fresh sample transport requirements, preventing loss of moisture; air content and slump frequency and control chart action/suspension limits; beam mold water tightness, warping requirements; vibration and consolidation sequence; vibrator equipment inspection; initial curing moisture loss control and temperature criteria; transporting molded strength specimens to laboratory for final curing; and final curing temperatures and conditioning.
key_points: Verify sampling location, frequency, and randomness requirements on grade
Verify fresh sample transport prevents moisture loss, and beam molds are watertight/non-warped
Verify vibration/consolidation sequence, initial curing moisture/temperature control, and final curing conditioning
sections.applicability: Applies to the checklist for concrete strength specimen sampling, fabrication, and curing.

sections.title: B-2.3: Concrete Flexural Strength Testing
sections.summary: Flexural strength testing checklist: machine calibration/setup; loading rate requirements; sample preparation; leather shims or grinding for beam testing; moisture control during testing; loading rate; measuring beam dimensions; strength calculation; documentation of sample deficiencies.
sections.body: Concrete flexural strength testing checklist items: machine calibration and setup; loading rate requirements; sample preparation; leather shims or grinding for beam testing; moisture control during testing; loading rate; measuring beam dimensions; strength calculation; and documentation of sample deficiencies.
key_points: Verify test machine calibration/setup and loading rate requirements
Verify sample preparation (leather shims or grinding) and moisture control during testing
Verify beam dimension measurement, strength calculation, and documentation of any sample deficiencies
sections.applicability: Applies to the checklist supporting Chapter 10, Section 10-4.7.1's flexural strength testing guidance.

sections.title: B-2.4: Core Length (Thickness) Testing
sections.summary: Core length testing checklist: random test locations; number of measurements; average core length determination.
sections.body: Core length (thickness) testing checklist items: random locations; number of measurements; and average core length determination.
key_points: Verify core testing locations are randomly selected
Verify the number of measurements and the average core length determination method
sections.applicability: Applies to the checklist supporting Chapter 10, Section 10-4.5's thickness testing guidance.

sections.title: B-2.5: Smoothness Testing
sections.summary: Smoothness testing checklist: straightedge and profile equipment; recommended timing; grinding limits.
sections.body: Smoothness testing checklist items: straightedge and profile equipment; recommended timing; and grinding limits.
key_points: Verify straightedge/profile equipment type used and testing timing
Verify grinding limits are respected when correcting smoothness deficiencies
sections.applicability: Applies to the checklist supporting Chapter 10, Section 10-5.3's surface smoothness testing guidance.
